captions.detailed: A toll highway gate arm featuring a rectangular grey control booth post with a black top cap and base plate. A long, light grey boom arm is attached via a black pivot assembly, accented with red diagonal stripe indicators. The boom arm pivots upwards on a horizontal revolute joint to allow traffic passage.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated toll highway gate arm. The model should include a rectangular grey support post with a black cap and base, and a long light grey boom arm detailed with red warning stripes that rotates vertically via a revolute joint.
captions.factory: The model is constructed in two main parts. The base post is built using a series of box primitives representing the wide base, the main vertical column, a black top cap, and side panel details. The boom arm assembly is created from a long rectangular box for the main arm, combined with a cylindrical pivot mount and a series of smaller red box primitives rotated and spaced along the arm to form the warning stripes. A revolute joint is defined at the pivot center to enable vertical rotation.
